nuggets.text: CJ Carr is the grandson of Lloyd Carr, who coached Michigan to the 1997 national title, and his dad Jason played QB for Michigan.
The Hesburgh Library mural visible from Notre Dame Stadium, The Word of Life, is better known as "Touchdown Jesus."
Notre Dame Stadium's end zones carry no school name, just nine diagonal white lines pointing toward the Golden Dome.
Knute Rockne helped design Notre Dame Stadium, keeping the stands as close to the field as possible; it opened in 1930.
Notre Dame Stadium switched to artificial turf in 2014 after 84 seasons on natural grass.
The Fighting Irish's opener at Lambeau Field was the first college game at the Packers' home since 2016.
Colorado transfer DJ McKinney returned an interception 55 yards untouched for a touchdown in the Irish win over Wisconsin.
Marcus Freeman is the first African American and first Asian American head coach to reach a D-I national title game.
Aneyas Williams ran for 90 yards and two touchdowns in the opener, filling in for NFL draft picks Jeremiyah Love and Jadarian Price.
The Fighting Irish are chasing their first national championship since 1988.
